title: WordPress multisite migration: the one-Sunday playbook
lede: A Plesk box on PHP 7.4 with a 12-site multisite, a fresh VPS waiting at Hetzner, and a Sunday from 09:00 to 17:00 to get the cutover done before Monday traffic.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of inked WordPress multisite migration plan on graph paper with index cards, manila tab, brass plate, wax seal.
